title: Capital-aware advisor tier table (T-280 spec)
_doc: SPEC ARTIFACT for T-2026-07-02-280 — NOT yet wired to runtime (the build is assigned after B/T-278 + C/T-279).
advisor(wrapper, equity) -> the single row whose (wrapper, [equity_min,equity_max)) contains the input.
A row is SELECTABLE for a live deploy ONLY if status=='validated' AND validation_ref points at a merged, non-refuted audit.
Absent/pending/refuted -> fail-conservative fallback: nearest validated LOWER band (same wrapper) -> Roth-equiv de-rated -> HALT.

equity_max.description: exclusive band ceiling; null = open-ended top

lookback.description: trend overlay lookback in trading days (105 = 5mo today)

car25_tolerance.description: T-151 safe-f / CAR25 drawdown-tolerance knob (glide-path input)

validation_ref.description: MANDATORY. task id + audit doc that earned this row. pending:<taskid> if not yet validated. TAXABLE rows must reference an AFTER-TAX gauntlet (T-191) measured vs the TLH-enhanced robo benchmark.

tax_home_preference.description: T-280b asset-location: which account this strategy prefers. roth-preferred = high-turnover/tax-inefficient (sleeve, premium legs); taxable-required = needs margin/short/futures permissions; either = long-only low-turnover.

s1256.description: true = broad-based index futures/options getting IRC 1256 blended 60/40 treatment; overrides the taxable prefer-low-turnover rule and the after-tax gauntlet must apply 1256, not ordinary-income.

paper_evidence.description: does the paper machine's pinned-equity evidence cover this row's capability?
